quote: Text summarization is evaluated using the XSum and CNN/DailyMail datasets with the BART Large model
We evaluate the effectiveness of the proposed RoCoFT method across various NLP tasks, including ... text summarization. We use the XSum and CNN/DailyMail datasets with the BART Large model.

Adapting Large Language Models (LLMs) to different downstream applications is the current prevailing paradigm for solving many Natural Language Processing (NLP) problems, such as sentiment analysis, machine translation, question answering, named entity recognition, and text summarization.
the RoCoFT 3-Column attains the top ROUGE-2 score of 18.54 on XSum
We report ROUGE-2 scores for summarization and Exact Match/F1 for QA, along with accuracy for classification tasks.

For the Semantic Textual Similarity Benchmark (STS-B) task, which requires predicting the degree of semantic similarity between sentence pairs, we use both the Pearson and Spearman correlation coefficients.
